tiers.everyday: Bow Bells are the bells of St Mary-le-Bow in London. They were destroyed in the Great Fire of 1666 and again in a 1941 air raid, and the present twelve bells were first rung in 1961.
tiers.student: The church's history: lost in 1666; a peal of eight in 1677; tenor recast by Thomas Lester in 1738; twelve from 1881; recast by Gillett & Johnston in 1933; destroyed on 11 May 1941; recast at Whitechapel in 1956 using salvaged metal and first rung on 21 December 1961. A classic English change-ringing ring.
